description: Bonescythe Breastplate Level 60 Rohan the Assassin at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make a Bonescythe Breastplate if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Breastplate, 25 Wartorn Leather Scraps, 2 Arcanite Bars and 6 Cured Rugged Hides. Requirements: - Desecrated Breastplate - Wartorn Leather Scrap x 25 - Arcanite Bar x 2 - Cured Rugged Hide x 6
name: Bonescythe Breastplate
